extracted.intended_audience: students and scholars of classical geometry, mathematical historians, and readers studying Archimedes' propositions
extracted.subtask_description: Reading and interpreting Archimedes' geometric propositions and his treatise On Floating Bodies (Part II) together with the accompanying Book of Lemmas; focuses on statements, constructions, and proofs about paraboloids, circles, semicircles, and related equilibrium results. Intended to support understanding of classical proofs and geometric constructions.
